title: Aureline M5 compare-guard-banner component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the compare-guard-banner family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). A compare guard banner names why a comparison is guarded and what the guard permits so a banner never silently allows an apples-to-apples comparison the guard should block. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
